description: Trace a delegation from the root to the authority: each referral and its glue, the one server that answered at each zone cut and any dial that failed, the final answer and its TTLs. Each hop is asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, named on the hop. Give the full host name: the walk ends at the zone that answers for it, and type (default A) is what it asks there.

name.description: The name to walk. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: Record type for the final question

name: trace

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

askAgain.description: The isitdns.net page that asks it again, when one does

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

report.description: headline, steps, the TTL facts, meaning

trace.description: query, readAt, hops, failed dials, finalAnswer, warnings

title: Trace a delegation
